head: LAB Cam Pro: film camera app for RAW photos on iPhone and Mac
dek: LAB Cam Pro is a new $4.99 camera and darkroom app that gives RAW photos the look of a chosen film stock, with grain and glow, and keeps the original. It was #51 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on November 13.
details: You get manual shutter, ISO, focus and exposure, frames from 35mm to 6x7 and XPAN, and many color, black-and-white and motion film stocks; the stock can be changed later. The price includes 30 days of 64 GB cloud storage; after that, cloud plans start at $1.99 a month and the library otherwise stays on your devices. Version 1.0.1 added iPhone Duo support and opening from the Lock Screen and Camera Control. The maker is Aiden Magarian.
where: iPhone (iOS 18 or later) and Mac with an M1 chip or later, $4.99 with in-app purchases
means: If you like the film look, this app shoots RAW and adds it afterwards, so you can change your mind later.
todo: Check the cloud plan prices on the listing before the free 30 days run out.
